rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something present or operating everywhere.

example.english: This kind of advertising is pervasive; you see it everywhere.
example.traditional: 呢種廣告無處不在，行到邊都見到。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 gwong2 gou3 mou4 cyu3 bat1 zoi6 haang4 dou3 bin1 dou1 gin3 dou2

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase for something visibly found all around, especially in concrete everyday situations.

example.english: Nowadays shared bikes are pervasive; you see them all over the streets.
example.traditional: 而家啲共享單車周圍都有，成條街都見到。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 di1 gung6 hoeng2 daan1 ce1 zau1 wai4 dou1 jau5 sing4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 gin3 dou2

rows.note: Use this for an influence, message, or problem that penetrates everywhere, often with an invasive or negative nuance.

example.english: Those spam messages are pervasive and invasive; they even get into text messages.
example.traditional: 嗰啲垃圾訊息真係無孔不入，連手機短訊都有。
example.jyutping: go2 di1 laap6 saap3 seon3 sik1 zan1 hai6 mou4 hong2 bat1 jap6 lin4 sau2 gei1 dyun2 seon3 dou1 jau5
